meta.title: Torque Converter — Convert Newton-meter and More
meta.description: Free torque converter for 5+ units including Newton-meter, Kilonewton-meter, Foot-pound. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Newton-meters, foot-pounds. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 5 torque units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for torque in this tool is **Nm**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most torque conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Newton-meter | N·m |
| Kilonewton-meter | kN·m |
| Foot-pound | ft·lb |
| Inch-pound | in·lb |
| Kilogram-force meter | kgf·m |
content.use_cases:
- Reading datasheets where SI and imperial units appear side by side.
- Cross-checking CAD drawings against fabrication specs in a different system.
- Converting torque, pressure, or stress values for procurement.
- Translating field measurements into engineering reports.
- Spec'ing parts from international suppliers.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this torque converter?
**A:** It uses 5 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Newton-meter (N·m), Kilonewton-meter (kN·m), Foot-pound (ft·lb), Inch-pound (in·lb), Kilogram-force meter (kgf·m).
